name: Claude Skill Library
summary: Personal library of Claude skills shipped as one downloadable zip that you upload into Claude; unlocked with an email code.
description: A collection of Claude skills — chat commands like /grill-me — that the author uses every day. Install by downloading the zip, turning on Skills in Claude's settings, then uploading it via Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill. The skills unlock after a six-digit email code, and the list itself loads on the page.
